data.credibility: Management generally delivers on near-term targets like value growth and project phases, achieving 4.9% value growth against a 4-6% target and commissioning VAM-VAE in H1 FY27. However, longer-term margin guidance is maintained even as EBITDA margins steadily narrow from 22.4% to 18.9%.

lines.line: Promised mid-single-digit value growth; delivered 4.9% for FY26, meeting the 4 to 6 percent target.
Targeted 8 to 10 percent volume growth for Q4 FY26; delivered 12.4%.
Endeavoured to maintain PBDIT margin between 18 and 20 percent; tracking at 18.2% in FY27.
Targeted high single-digit volume growth for FY27; currently on track.
Expected to commission the first phase of the VAM-VAE project in H1 FY27; delivered.
Aimed for VAE capacity near 150,000 MT over 2-2.5 years; status is on track.

bull: Robust cash conversion: operating cash flow was 109% of reported profit over 5 years, ensuring profits turn into cash.
Strong balance sheet: borrowings of ₹4,596 cr against net worth of ₹21,735 cr yield a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.21.
Proven capacity delivery: management successfully commissioned the first phase of the VAM-VAE project in H1 FY27 as promised.
bear: Slowing growth momentum: revenue growth slowed to 1.0% a year over three years compared to 10.4% over five years.
Margin compression: EBITDA margin narrowed from 22.4% in FY21 down to 18.8% in FY26, pressuring profitability.
Rising debt levels: total borrowings increased more than fourfold from ₹1,093 cr in FY21 to ₹4,596 cr.
